messages.author: fecbe3dc811bed89
messages.subject: Global Optimizers
parts:
Hi Phil,

A lot of global optimizers are available in R (https://cran.r-project.org/web/views/Optimization.html), such as DEoptim. How to use them in mirt? Thanks.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Global Optimizers
parts:
You'd have to customize the internals to use these, particularly in this source file: https://github.com/philchalmers/mirt/blob/master/R/EMstep.utils.R. That being said, why do you need these? Do you think the M-step is hitting global minimums somehow?  

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Global Optimizers
parts:
Sure, but that's not the problem. Local minimums might occur in the observed log likelihood, but these occur regardless of whether the M step has local mins. You may have no minimums in the mstep yet still hit a local min (this is a problem with the EM, so in mirt this likely isn't a good solution).

Phil
